# g3-toolkit

> Composable graph-visualization component LIBRARY (not a framework) for
> RDF, labeled-property-graph (LPG), and holonic data: @g3t/core (zero
> React), @g3t/react (views + controls), @g3t/charts (linked ECharts).
> Hosts integrate through exactly three channels: exported zustand
> stores, props/callbacks, and versioned JSON documents. TypeScript,
> React 19, pnpm (enforced), Cytoscape + Graphology, Zustand.

The native data model is the UGM, a labeled property graph (typed nodes
and edges with arbitrary properties) over Graphology. Everything else
(RDF triples, relational rows, holonic datasets) projects into it.
Reasoning and heavy algorithms run UPSTREAM (triplestore, networkx,
GraphBLAS) and arrive as validated result documents: "results, not
computation".

## Packages and entry points

- @g3t/core (no React): subpath exports `.` (UGM, algorithms, export,
  SHACL, structural layout), `./adapters` , `./middleware`, `./events`,
  `./projection`, `./pipeline`, `./shacl`, `./diff`, `./layout`,
  `./algorithms`, `./undo-redo`, `./theme`, `./path-analysis`.
- @g3t/react: subpath exports `.`, `./views`, `./controls`, `./state`,
  `./theme`, `./a11y`, `./icons`, and `./style.css` (REQUIRED import,
  see rules below). Peer deps are NOT auto-installed: react, react-dom,
  cytoscape, cytoscape-fcose, zustand, echarts, vis-timeline, vis-data
  (the vis-* pair is statically imported today, install it even if the
  timeline view is unused).
- @g3t/charts: `LinkedChart` (bar, scatter, line, pie), auto-links to
  the shared selection store. Peers: react, echarts.

## Core API surface (the names an agent should reach for)

- Data model: `UGM`, `SerializedUGM`, node/edge input and attribute types.
- Backends: `SparqlAdapter` (SELECT bindings only), `CypherAdapter`,
  `GremlinAdapter`, `RestAdapter`, `HolonicAdapter`; `Middleware` on all.
- RDF to LPG: `createPresetPipeline("standard" | "ontology" |
  "provenance-preserving").project(rdfGraph)` or compose a
  `ProjectionPipeline` with steps like `typeCollapse`.
- SHACL: `validateShacl`, `reportFromValidationResults`,
  `parseShaclReport`, `severityOverlays`, `shaclResultDrivers`,
  `shaclShapesToStructural`, `shaclRowSeverities`, `closedShapeIds`.
- Structural (UML/SysML-style) layout: `layoutStructural`,
  `isChainEdgeId`, `routeStructuralEdges` (pure edge router, for live
  re-route during drags; opt-in `nudge` option separates parallel
  runs into distinct tracks); rendered by `StructuralSvgView`.
- Algorithms and scale: `parseAlgorithmResult`, `applyAlgorithmResult`,
  `ingestAlgorithmResults`, `findShortestPath`, `allShortestPaths`,
  `collapseByCluster`, `buildSubgraph`, `computeIncrementalUpdate`,
  `applyIncrementalLayout`.
- Export: `exportSubgraphJson`, `exportSubgraphCsv`, `exportSubgraphTurtle`.
- Events: `G3tEventBus` (context-menu actions emit on it).

React: `CytoscapeCanvas` (props: ugm, encodingSpec, stylesheet, hidden,
containment, layout, layoutOptions, interactionOptions, edgeStyle,
animate, menuManager, structural + structuralDecorations +
structuralEdgeLayer (the structural path is DEPRECATED, see rules
below), onReady which hands you the Cytoscape Core),
`StructuralSvgView` + `useStructuralLayout`, `relayoutAroundFixed`,
`useElementPointerEvents`, `GraphToolbar`,
`EncodingSpecPanel`, `SpecLegend`, `FloatingLegend`, `AlgorithmPanel`,
`LayoutManager`, `Minimap`, `ProvenanceTrace`, `NodeStyleEditor`,
`SearchBar`, `FacetFilter`, `FilterBuilder`, `ContextMenuManager`,
`createDefaultMenuManager`, `registerToolkitActions`, `runGraphLayout`,
`createCameraController`, `createTheme`, `applyEncodingSpec`,
`labelWrapRule` (word-wrap long node labels; pass via the `stylesheet`
prop, a position-preserving restyle),
`captureWorkspace` / `applyWorkspace` / `serializeWorkspace`, plus view
components: TableView, TreeView, TimelineView, MapView, MatrixView,
SankeyView, SchemaView, StatsPanel, QueryEditor, ShaclShapeBrowser,
DiffRenderer. Stores: `useSelectionStore`, `usePositionPinStore`,
`useOverlayStore`, `useThemeStore`, `useStyleOverrideStore`
(usable from React via selector or anywhere via `.getState()` /
`.subscribe()`).

## Correctness rules (types cannot express these; violating them is the
## most common AI-generated-code failure)

- Import `"@g3t/react/style.css"` FIRST. Without it every view renders
  unstyled with no error.
- `ugm` is compared by IDENTITY. Memoize it in the host; a new instance
  means "different graph" and re-runs layout. Content changes to
  `containment`, `layout`, `layoutOptions`, `interactionOptions`,
  `edgeStyle`, `animate` also re-initialize. `stylesheet` and
  `encodingSpec` changes are style refreshes and preserve positions.
- Filter by HIDING: pass node ids as `hidden` (a batched restyle).
  Never feed a pre-filtered UGM as `ugm`.
- For a genuinely different scene, use a keyed remount:
  `<CytoscapeCanvas key={sceneId} ugm={ugm} />`.
- Structural scenes: render with `StructuralSvgView` (the ruled
  path). Passing `layoutStructural` geometry to `CytoscapeCanvas` via
  the `structural` prop is DEPRECATED (owner ruling 2026-07-28; a
  dev-only warning fires) and will be removed once remaining
  consumers migrate.
- Deterministic styling escape hatch: the `_color` / `_shape` data
  channels. Reserved encoding channels reject by owner name.
- Graphs past ~5k nodes: collapse with `collapseByCluster`, drill in
  with `buildSubgraph`. There is no canvas virtualization.

## Honest limits

SPARQL adapter parses SELECT bindings only (no CONSTRUCT/DESCRIBE, no
full RDF-term typing). No SHACL-over-arbitrary-RDF shapes parser (the
validator uses the toolkit's internal shape form). No OWL/RDFS
reasoning, no named graphs/quads. Adapters are unit-tested against
mocked responses, not live backends. Structural compartment
expand/collapse was REMOVED by ruling (2026-07-10):
`useCompartmentCollapseStore`, `registerCompartmentCollapseActions`,
`compartmentKey`, and the `collapsedCompartments` layout input no
longer exist, even where older wiring-guide sections still show them.
Details:
[capabilities-and-limits](https://github.com/zwelz3/g3-toolkit/blob/main/docs/capabilities-and-limits.md).

- [Wiring guide](https://github.com/zwelz3/g3-toolkit/blob/main/docs/wiring-guide.md):

- [README](https://github.com/zwelz3/g3-toolkit/blob/main/README.md):
  install, packages, minimal 15-line integration, honest scope,
  theming.
- [Capability index](https://github.com/zwelz3/g3-toolkit/blob/main/docs/capability-index.md):
  intent to demo/recipe/story lookup table.
- [Consuming g3t](https://github.com/zwelz3/g3-toolkit/blob/main/docs/consuming-g3t.md):
  adopter-side integration guide.

  UML/SysML structural-scene recipes.
- [API reference (typedoc)](https://zwelz3.github.io/g3-toolkit/api/)
- [Playground](https://zwelz3.github.io/g3-toolkit/playground/): five
  domain shells (Ontology, Auditor, MBSE, Supply Chain, Biomedical) +
  capability dashboards (Analytics, Scale, Style Lab, Routing Lab —
  hard edge-routing scenarios graded live), live in the browser. The
  landing footer links this file, AGENTS.md, and the wiring guide.
- [Storybook](https://zwelz3.github.io/g3-toolkit/storybook/)
